name: EntityDrawBench
description: A benchmark for evaluating text-to-image generation models on diverse entities ranging from frequent to rare across multiple object categories such as dogs, foods, landmarks, birds, and characters. It measures the fidelity and accuracy of generated images especially for less frequent entities.
typical_sota_score: Varies by metric and split; human_eval ratings often range widely (≈60–95% depending on entity and model) and FID scores typically span roughly 10–40 across modern text-to-image models
reputation: A niche but recognized benchmark for text-to-image entity fidelity, especially useful for probing rare-concept generation beyond common prompt sets.
notes: Evaluates generation fidelity for rare and unseen entities using retrieval-augmented generation.
